data_facts_with_vis_data.paragraph: India surpassed China as the most populated country in the world in 2023. data_facts_with_vis_data.paragraph: The United States is currently the third most populated country in the world, but is expected to drop to fourth most populated sometime before 2060. The African country of Nigeria, whose growth rate is 2.08% (compared to 0.54% in the US) will become the third most populated country in the world. While UN predictions vary from those of the US Census Bureau, Nigeria takes the lead in both projections. Nigeriaâ\x80\x99s population is expected to reach 400 million by 2060, while the US will have approximately 389 million people.
